risk_title: Compromise of the centralized train control system
risk_scenario: Malware or unauthorised access reaches the CTC/SCADA network through the IT to OT bridge and lets someone issue or block movement authorities
vulnerability: IT/OT segmentation is a policy that has not been proven under test; vendor remote access and hybrid cloud give three routes into OT
target_rationale: Deny-all segmentation, PAM-brokered remote access and MFA make crossing into SCADA much harder, but impact stays 5 because the consequence is still a collision

risk_scenario: Signalling and interlocking commands are manipulated or spoofed, producing a wrong-side failure
threat_source: Attacker with OT knowledge, physical access
vulnerability: Signalling commands are not authenticated or integrity monitored
target_rationale: Command authentication and integrity monitoring remove the realistic remote path; only a physical, specialist attack remains

risk_scenario: Legacy and end-of-life OT components cannot be patched without a service possession, so known vulnerabilities stay open for long periods
vulnerability: Unsupported OT components on a 20 to 30 year lifecycle with public exploits
target_rationale: Isolation, a recorded exception per unsupported system and a possession-based patch route cut exposure; residual stays High until the Year 3 replacement plan lands

risk_scenario: Trackside and onboard IoT sensors are spoofed or tampered with and feed false telemetry into maintenance and operational decisions
threat_source: Attacker with physical or RF access
vulnerability: Shared or default device credentials, unauthenticated radio links, unstaffed rural cabinets
target_rationale: Device authentication lowers likelihood and telemetry validation means false readings are rejected before they drive a decision

risk_scenario: Ransomware encrypts the e-ticketing and reservation platform during a peak travel period
vulnerability: Internet-facing revenue system, incomplete MFA and patching, untested restores
target_rationale: MFA, patching and detection lower likelihood; immutable backups with a measured restore time cut the outage from weeks to hours, so impact drops to 4

risk_title: Broken access control in app and portal APIs
risk_scenario: Broken access control in the app and portal APIs exposes other passengers' bookings and personal data
vulnerability: Missing object-level authorisation checks on public APIs
target_rationale: Object-level authorisation and pre-release API testing make the flaw unlikely to reach production; impact unchanged if it does

risk_scenario: Fare fraud through cloned cards, replayed QR tickets or tampered smart gate readers
vulnerability: Static QR tickets, unattended gate readers
target_rationale: Fare evasion never reaches zero; token validation and anomaly monitoring keep it a small financial leak

risk_scenario: Crew scheduling and rostering data is lost or corrupted, forcing manual rostering and service cancellations
vulnerability: Internal system reachable only as a second stage target
treatment_source: Project (Medium risk within appetite; manual rostering workaround exists)
target_rationale: Accepted: manual rostering is a tested workaround; reviewed annually by the Risk Committee

risk_scenario: Mass exfiltration of the passenger master database including identity, payment and travel history records
vulnerability: Database reachable from ticketing, APIs and cloud analytics; no bulk extraction monitoring
target_rationale: Least privilege, field-level encryption and bulk-read alerting lower likelihood; impact stays 5 because leaked identity data cannot be recalled

risk_scenario: Cloud misconfiguration, public storage or over-permissive IAM exposes backups and operational APIs
vulnerability: Multiple teams with deploy access, no configuration baseline or drift detection
target_rationale: Baselines with drift detection catch misconfiguration quickly; encryption limits what an exposed bucket reveals

risk_scenario: Data poisoning or unmanaged model drift in the predictive maintenance engine causes real defects to be missed
threat_source: Attacker with data pipeline access, or neglect
vulnerability: No model inventory, dataset approval or drift monitoring
target_rationale: Drift monitoring plus mandatory engineer sign-off on safety calls means a degrading model is noticed before a defect is missed

risk_title: Backups and DR site not recoverable
risk_scenario: Backups or the DR site turn out not to be recoverable when they are actually needed
vulnerability: Restores and DR failover have never been timed or tested
target_rationale: Quarterly timed restore drills turn an assumed recovery into a measured one

risk_scenario: CCTV cameras and recorders running default credentials or exposed to the internet are used as a foothold or for surveillance
treatment_source: Project (Medium risk within appetite; monitor through the SOC)
target_rationale: Accepted with SOC monitoring; revisit if CCTV is connected to the operational network

risk_scenario: Phishing or business email compromise leads to credential theft and lateral movement
target_rationale: Phishing will keep arriving; filtering lowers likelihood slightly and MFA makes a stolen password far less useful

risk_title: Privileged insider misuse and stale accounts
risk_scenario: Privileged insider misuse, or an admin account that was never revoked after someone left
vulnerability: Manual joiner-mover-leaver process and no access recertification
target_rationale: Automated deprovisioning removes stale accounts; PAM checkout and session recording shrink what one account can do, so impact drops to 4

risk_title: Third party and supply chain compromise
risk_scenario: Third party or supply chain compromise through vendor remote access or a poisoned software update
vulnerability: Standing vendor access, no security clauses or notification SLA in contracts
target_rationale: Time-bound PAM vendor sessions lower likelihood; contract security annexes transfer part of the financial impact

risk_scenario: SOC and SIEM blind spots: OT and cloud logs are not collected, so an incident runs undetected for weeks
vulnerability: No log collection from OT and trackside IoT; one cloud region not shipping flow logs
target_rationale: A minimum logging standard with quarterly coverage checks and exercises cuts dwell time
